drafts.definitionEn: The part of a town that is next to the sea, especially the area with a road or buildings facing it.
drafts.definitionUz: Shaharning dengizga tutash qismi, ayniqsa qirg‘oq bo‘yidagi yo‘l yoki binolar joylashgan hudud.

examples.textEn: You can cycle along the seafront.

drafts.definitionEn: A long, narrow boat with a dragon design, used for races in which a team paddles together.
drafts.definitionUz: Jamoa birgalikda eshkak eshadigan poygalarda ishlatiladigan, ajdarho shaklida bezatilgan uzun va tor qayiq.

examples.textEn: We want to enter a team in the dragon boat race.
examples.textUz: Biz ajdarho qayig‘i poygasiga jamoa sifatida qatnashmoqchimiz.

drafts.definitionEn: A piece of safety clothing that keeps a person floating in water.
drafts.definitionUz: Suvda odamni suzib turishiga yordam beradigan xavfsizlik kiyimi.

examples.textEn: Everyone wears a life jacket.

drafts.definitionEn: A comfortable sports shoe worn for exercise or as casual footwear (British English).
drafts.definitionUz: Sport mashqlari yoki kundalik kiyim uchun mo‘ljallangan qulay oyoq kiyimi (Britaniya inglizchasi).

examples.textEn: Most people wear a T-shirt, shorts and trainers.
examples.textUz: Ko‘pchilik futbolka, shortik va krossovka kiyadi.

drafts.definitionEn: The youngest or oldest age allowed for someone to take part in an activity.
drafts.definitionUz: Faoliyatda qatnashish uchun ruxsat etilgan eng kichik yoki eng katta yosh.

examples.textEn: There is no age limit for the event.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to show a particular place, point or position.
drafts.definitionUz: Aniq joy yoki nuqtani ko‘rsatadigan predlog.

examples.textEn: The race is at the Brighton Marina.

drafts.definitionEn: Inside or within a place, area, or container.
drafts.definitionUz: Biror joy, hudud yoki idishning ichida bo‘lishni ko‘rsatadigan predlog.

examples.textEn: The boats turn over in the water.

drafts.definitionEn: Used before a day or date to show when something happens.
drafts.definitionUz: Voqea sodir bo‘ladigan kun yoki sanani bildiradigan predlog.

examples.textEn: It is taking place on the second of July.
examples.textUz: U ikkinchi iyul kuni bo‘lib o‘tadi.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to express a reaction such as surprise, understanding, disappointment, or pleasure.
drafts.definitionUz: Hayrat, tushunish, xafa bo‘lish yoki quvonch kabi munosabatni bildiradigan undov so‘z.

examples.textEn: Oh yes, I know it.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to introduce a relative clause that gives information about a person.
drafts.definitionUz: Shaxs haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beruvchi aniqlovchi ergash gapni boshlaydigan olmosh.

examples.textEn: Every crew member who takes part in the race can enter the prize draw.
examples.textUz: Poygada qatnashadigan har bir ekipaj a’zosi sovrinli qur’ada qatnashishi mumkin.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to introduce a defining relative clause about a person or thing.
drafts.definitionUz: Shaxs yoki narsa haqidagi aniqlovchi ergash gapni boshlaydigan olmosh.

examples.textEn: We have boats that turn over in the water.
examples.textUz: Bizda suvda ag‘darilib ketadigan qayiqlar bor.

drafts.definitionEn: A competition in which people are entered for the chance to win a prize, with the winner chosen randomly.
drafts.definitionUz: G‘olib tasodifiy qur’a orqali tanlanadigan sovrinli tanlov.

examples.textEn: Every crew member will be entered into a free prize draw.
examples.textUz: Har bir ekipaj a’zosi bepul sovrinli qur’ada ishtirok etadi.

drafts.definitionEn: To be obliged or required to do something.
drafts.definitionUz: Biror ishni bajarish zarur yoki majburiy bo‘lishi.

examples.textEn: All team members have to get their parents' permission if they are under eighteen.
examples.textUz: O‘n sakkiz yoshga to‘lmagan jamoa a’zolari ota-onasidan ruxsat olishi kerak.

drafts.definitionEn: In addition; also.
drafts.definitionUz: Oldin aytilgan ma’lumotga yana bir narsani qo‘shish uchun ishlatiladi.

examples.textEn: Everyone wears a life jacket as well.

drafts.definitionEn: Used at the start of an answer, explanation or conversation turn to organize what is said next.
drafts.definitionUz: Javob yoki tushuntirishni boshlash va fikrni bog‘lash uchun ishlatiladigan kirish so‘z.

examples.textEn: Well, you need to have a crew of twenty people.

drafts.definitionEn: By a priority class of postal service, usually with faster delivery.
drafts.definitionUz: Xat yoki jo‘natmani ustuvor toifali pochta xizmati orqali yuborish usuli.

examples.textEn: I'll be happy to send details first class.
examples.textUz: Ma’lumotlarni birinchi toifali pochta orqali yuborishdan mamnun bo‘laman.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to express that somebody is able to do something.
drafts.definitionUz: Biror ishni bajarish qobiliyati yoki imkoniyati borligini bildiruvchi modal fe’l.

examples.textEn: More people can take part then.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to refer to an action or event expected or intended in the future.
drafts.definitionUz: Kelajakda bo‘lishi kutilayotgan yoki rejalashtirilgan ish-harakatni bildiruvchi modal fe’l.

examples.textEn: Every crew member will receive a T-shirt.
examples.textUz: Har bir ekipaj a’zosi futbolka oladi.

drafts.definitionEn: Used with I or we to refer to future actions, especially in formal speech.
drafts.definitionUz: Rasmiy uslubda birinchi shaxs bilan kelajak harakatini ifodalovchi modal fe’l.

examples.textEn: Now we shall begin.

drafts.definitionEn: Used with a present participle to form a continuous verb tense, or with a past participle to form a passive construction.
drafts.definitionUz: Davomiy zamon yoki majhul nisbat shakllarini hosil qilish uchun ishlatiladigan yordamchi fe’l.

examples.textEn: The race is being held on Sunday.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to form questions and negative statements in the simple present or past tense.
drafts.definitionUz: Oddiy zamonda so‘roq va inkor gaplarini tuzishda ishlatiladigan yordamchi fe’l.

examples.textEn: Do all the team members have to be a certain age?
examples.textUz: Jamoaning barcha a’zolari ma’lum yoshda bo‘lishi shartmi?

drafts.definitionEn: Used with a past participle to form the perfect tenses.
drafts.definitionUz: Perfect zamon shakllarini yasashda past participle bilan ishlatiladigan yordamchi fe’l.

examples.textEn: I've got a group of twenty people.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to greet somebody when meeting them or beginning a conversation.
drafts.definitionUz: Uchrashganda yoki suhbat boshida salomlashish uchun ishlatiladigan undov so‘z.

examples.textEn: Oh hello. I'm ringing about the race.
examples.textUz: Oh, salom. Poyga haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapman.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to express agreement, acceptance, or acknowledgement.
drafts.definitionUz: Rozilik, qabul qilish yoki tushunganlikni bildiruvchi undov so‘z.

examples.textEn: Okay.

drafts.definitionEn: Used in conversation to show agreement, understanding, or a change of topic.
drafts.definitionUz: Suhbatda rozilik yoki tushunishni bildiruvchi, ba’zan yangi mavzuga o‘tkazuvchi so‘z.

examples.textEn: Right. And what time does the race start?

drafts.definitionEn: Used to confirm that something is obvious, expected, or willingly agreed to.
drafts.definitionUz: Biror narsa tabiiy, kutilgan yoki bajonidil qabul qilinganini tasdiqlovchi ibora.

examples.textEn: Of course.

drafts.definitionEn: Used to add more detailed information or emphasize what is true.
drafts.definitionUz: Ma’lumotni aniqlashtirish yoki fikrni kuchaytirish uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

examples.textEn: In fact, it's a very good idea to bring some spare clothes.
examples.textUz: Aslida, qo‘shimcha kiyim olib kelish yaxshi fikr.

drafts.definitionEn: In the exact sense mentioned, or considered strictly in that capacity.
drafts.definitionUz: Narsani aynan aytilgan ma’noda yoki holatda nazarda tutishni bildiradi.

examples.textEn: There's no age limit as such.
examples.textUz: Aynan yosh chegarasi deb aytadigan cheklov yo‘q.

drafts.definitionEn: A short form of who is or who has.
drafts.definitionUz: Who is yoki who has birikmalarining qisqartma shakli.

examples.textEn: You need to agree on who's going to be the team captain.
examples.textUz: Kim jamoa sardori bo‘lishini kelishib olishingiz kerak.

drafts.definitionEn: A short form of where is or where has.
drafts.definitionUz: Where is yoki where has birikmalarining qisqartma shakli.

examples.textEn: And where's it being held?
